sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sha256 6d44970b...fd7f): Quality Checks row no_prebuilt_image_shadows_the_agent_dockerfile and the matching Internal Quality Checks annotation ('[environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps (which would skip it entirely)')
evidence: Frozen task/task.toml [environment] (lines 20-24) contains only build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2, memory_mb=4096; a grep for docker_image across the whole frozen task returns no match (also absent under [verifier.environment]). This is byte-identical in keys to the template's [environment] block (template task.toml lines 20-24). The agent Dockerfile (task/environment/Dockerfile) has active build steps: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt-get install (line 5), npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (line 9), COPY instructions/ and assets/ (lines 14-15), and the /app git init RUN (lines 16-23). Since no prebuilt image is configured, Harbor must build from this Dockerfile, so the COPY of /instructions and /assets and the pinned runtime are not dead code. Adversarial probes: a broken configuration that would pass this row requires docker_image to be set (it is not); a conforming alternative cannot fail because the check is a pure static absence condition. Static check; no runtime measurement is required for this row (agent image build success is covered by other rows).
